tasks.summary: Cancelled enemy movement rejects deferred destinations, action continuations and pacing callbacks; restores committed tile and sprite scale. Six movement action cancellation/reuse cases plus native tween interruption and restart pass. Full headless combat and focused native checks pass; final no-path waiter adjustment checked headlessly. No human visual/campaign/export QA. Next: status teardown and multi-floor save/resume.

Seven owned lunge tweens cancel pending hits/completion/residue and restore sprite/idle. Six baseline failures; focused headless/native real-project checks pass, including partial Horror resolution. Removed duplicate project/junction setup from four runner tools; auto-clean system-temp data. Removed .qa-tmp and obsolete operating guidance. Telemetry and nine Python checks pass. Movement/status cancellation and campaign save/resume remain.

Rift Echo four-HP cost uses existing direct damage, bypassing leftover block. Focused real-button checks cover 0/2/10 block, damage accounting and one-time rewards. Eight baseline failures; final focused headless run passes. Low-health event/death flow remains a separate candidate.

Corrective presentation pass, including actual player phase-out/in with cancellation-safe opacity and translucent shields (40-42%): synchronized surviving TileMap edge depth, alpha-aligned highlights, five-piece actual-art collapse and illustrated void atmosphere. Restored original impact/camera feedback, stronger number pop and dense card trail. New painted fast energy bolts and individually authored ability compositions follow actual behavior. Native 60 fps temporal review, two real shrinks, target/flight/29-signature checks, 640-resource shader/lunge regression, full headless combat, seed-42 AutoWalker (7 turns/27 actions, zero failures), art/resource checks pass. Preserve existing gameplay and unrelated work. See ai/docs/battlefield-vfx-overhaul.md; representative coverage and native/headless trace-parity limitation documented.

Centered feet, ground/hover/gate markers using cached artwork contact offsets; preserved scale and occupancy. Improved route contrast, opaque faces, labels/sidebar and trimmed connections. Added 25 card-specific signature scenes across six geometric/motion families with illustrated layers; distinct Overload/Sever/Void Shard projectiles and configured energy/cast feedback. Full combat, focused native anchor/map/FX tests, AutoWalker and art/resource checks pass. Temporary QA workspace absent. See ai/docs/battlefield-presentation.md.

Preserved tile art; added persistent per-unit ink/rim shader, ground presence, taller readable character scales and body picking, fixed half-size flying idle. Reworked fog/reveal, visible anchored spell strokes/projectiles/impacts, animated rift gates and teleport bursts. Fixed Echo Harvest zero payout, non-depletion and logical/world feedback coordinates. Full headless combat and focused native fog/HUD/harvest/teleport/picking checks pass; one seven-turn AutoWalker encounter has zero runtime failures. See ai/docs/battlefield-presentation.md.

64px TileSet/fog/overlays and proportional original characters; replaced eight-cell terrain atlas. Existing Phantom Camera owns HUD-aware tactical/overview/inspection framing; detached competing production Camera2D script and guarded inactive spotlight waits. Updated shader/VFX scale and ignored QA defaults. Focused native checks, art/resources, launcher tests and one headless AutoWalker encounter pass. See ai/docs/battlefield-presentation.md for validation limits and existing cube-distance discrepancy.

Theme-consistent illustrated FX: 8 sheets/64 frames, 4 particle extracts and illustrated target marker; revised arc shader/fade and projectile lifecycle, bounded feedback. Fixed legend mapping, hover duplication, HUD crystal/clock and Entering route label. Removed 67 superseded files/sidecars and rejected SVG. Native UI/combat, headless combat, asset/resource checks and offline/rendered battles pass. See ai/docs/icon-fx-followup.md.

29 original card illustrations in the user-approved stylized direction; exact-geometry environmental atlas; shader/alpha/ownership/lifetime fixes and bounded movement/summon feedback. Native card/terrain/targeting captures reviewed; actual offline combat/AutoWalker, art and resource checks pass. Removed collage pipeline, six shaders and legacy assets/card frame dependencies; one scene/theme renderer respects editor styling. Broad hardware/full campaign/export validation remains a limit. See ai/docs/visual-production.md.

Consolidated EncounterDefinition/EncounterRegistry, removed pool selector; preserved seven encounters and tier two. Added eight bases, twelve behavioral variants and twenty authored encounters. Integrated fixed illustrated masters across 29 cards, 32 unit/class sprites, 32 icons, terrain, main menu and all three class screens. Removed 88 old sources and 438 obsolete cache files; rejected art passes removed. Asset, combat and native compatibility checks pass; 27 headless encounters, one rendered elite and run startup/progression exercised without runtime failures. Full campaign, human balance and export QA remain limits. See ai/docs/rift-overhaul.md.

Fixed unsuccessful caravan trades consuming both event choices and repeat callbacks granting extra rewards. Existing costs are checked and charged once; currency signals refresh disabled buttons with requirement text, and completion focuses Leave. Regression baseline reproduced eleven failures; targeted offline headless/native and compatibility checks pass. Native event states inspected; no campaign/export QA. See ai/docs/continuous-improvement.md.

Fixed startup/run identity, per-session JSONL/counter reset, stale-report comparisons and v2 damage/healing/net-loss/cumulative-turn metrics. Added bounded trace/report/log storage plus age/size QA retention without following junctions or touching saves/caches. Default docs use configured backend; added read-only Grafana MCP setup. Updated backend schemas/tests/dashboards; deployment still required before live v2 uploads. Unit, targeted Godot and 292 real-event schema checks pass; full compatibility assertions pass with known shutdown diagnostics. No backend/Grafana access performed.

Handled Ctrl+C through isolated Godot process groups, interruptible polling and a bounded graceful stop request, preserving completed reports and returning 130. Moved existing QA artifacts/projects/saves under qa/, updated tools, scene/test paths, all affected docs, Git/import/export exclusions. Five lifecycle tests, headless/rendered simulated interruption and migrated default-path battle pass; standalone telemetry passes; controls assertions pass but existing shutdown retention still causes nonzero runner exit. No backend access.

Added a task-oriented AutoWalker user guide with first battle, Watch controls, batches, reports, replay, progression, comparison, option reference and troubleshooting. Separated usage from architecture and historical validation, linked from README, and checked CLI/source behavior and local documentation links. Documentation-only change; no gameplay or backend execution.

AutoWalker honors configured HTTP telemetry alongside independent local JSONL, with QA/bot context, consent, bounded shutdown drain and upload health. Added explicit offline launcher flag. Fake asynchronous transport tests pass without backend access; local encounter wins without failures. Existing controls shutdown-resource diagnostics remain; live backend delivery requires host verification.

Guarded draw callbacks and cancelled retained draw tweens when player/handler exits, with a deterministic mid-draw deletion regression. Compatibility runner exited 0 with 531 resources loaded and zero failed assertions; existing platform/shader/shutdown diagnostics remain. User's project/export/Watch-scene changes preserved.

Switched Grafana to internal ClickHouse native/9000 with provisioning version 2 to avoid HTTP server-hello failures. Static checks cover protocol, port and five-second driver deadline headroom. Read-only limits retained; no services launched. Live host verification remains required.

Handle non-JSON HTTP responses without engine parser errors, report transport/status/acknowledgement failures and preserve retry classification. Standalone tests pass for malformed responses, error statuses, invalid acknowledgements and connection failures. No backend services started.

Provisioned explicit 30-second Grafana query and connection max_execution_time settings within the ClickHouse reader's 60-second ceiling. Static validation compares settings with server constraints. No services launched; deployed verification requires pulling backend changes and restarting Grafana.

Made backend submodule self-contained with local Docker context/COPY paths, bundled event contract, local schema resolution, restricted build context and independent checkout documentation. Restored missing ClickHouse account/Grafana password fixes. Seven mocked ingestion tests and artifact checks pass from an isolated backend-only copy; Docker CLI unavailable, image build remains host validation. No services started or commits made.

Removed remaining Talo runtime/UI/export/test integration; validation uses isolated Null telemetry. Provisioned ClickHouse ingestion and Grafana accounts with environment passwords, explicit grants, bounded reader timeout changes and safe Grafana password substitution. Gameplay smoke, standalone addon, mocked ingestion and backend static checks pass; live backend authentication remains operator validation. No backend services started.

Fixed maximum-size events stalling minimum-size telemetry batches by counting commas only between events. Standalone regression reproduces the old empty-batch stall and verifies exact byte limits, FIFO acknowledgement progress and complete queue drainage after the fix.

Implemented combat victory/AI fixes, real-scene AutoWalker Watch/headless/policies/replay/run progression, standalone schema-aware telemetry addon, Talo event migration, and ingestion/ClickHouse/Grafana deployment source package. Local runtime and mocked/static backend evidence plus explicit shutdown/integration limits are recorded in ai/docs/implementation-checklist.md. No backend services started or deployed.

Migrated first-party UI to the shared Rift theme and named variations, authored fixed visuals as native scenes, repaired reward/shop layout and activation, and split run/battle HUDs, tutorials, pause, legend and sandbox panel into owned components. Removed private child injection and UI group discovery. Native scene save/reload ownership and interaction checks pass; see ai/docs/continuous-improvement.md for validation and shutdown limits.

Fixed shaders ignoring CanvasItem fade alpha, inverted outcome vignette, fullscreen scaling, frozen intros over paused tutorials, arbitrary victory timing and overlapping view lifetimes. Removed competing music-volume swells. Rendered zero/half/full alpha samples and transition completion checks pass; native texture shutdown diagnostics remain.

Fixed null-card draws from exhausted decks and animation-dependent discard state. Added runtime regression checks for phase ordering, interrupted/completed discard animations, immediate reshuffle, overdraw, zero-card draws, and standalone cleanup. See ai/docs/continuous-improvement.md for validation and limits.

Fixed two DataEditor enum lookups that used the inherited node name instead of the loop key. Added runtime scene-startup coverage for all enum dropdowns and resource-list initialization. Zero failed smoke assertions and no script errors; runner still reports the existing intermittent shutdown resource leaks.

Removed duplicated emission image data and generated-cache texture references from the newly converted run.tscn pause menu, reusing existing assets. Reduced scene from 9,916,548 to 35,936 bytes with node/connection sections unchanged. Resource guard passed; verbose compatibility runner exited 0 with 490 loads and zero failed assertions; existing intermittent shutdown diagnostics remain.

First architecture cleanup: externalized identical emission image data, shared ambient particle scene, removed first-party text-resource cache dependencies, authored battle presentation as a scene, added resource/overlay checks, and documented prioritized remaining work in ai/docs/godot-architecture-audit.md. Full-project cleanup remains open.

Reviewed Godot 4.7.2 and Talo 1.2.0 compatibility; migrated telemetry, repaired resource references and scene cleanup, updated CI/docs, and verified offline headless and D3D12 gameplay smoke tests. Remaining live-service/release validation and shutdown diagnostics are documented in ai/docs/godot-4.7.2-upgrade.md.
Fix end-of-battle audio stinger reliability and prevent repeated triggers.
Add impact profile kit (hit-stop, decals, scaled shakes) to damage handling for players and enemies.
Add punchy enemy death feedback (flash + smoke VFX, shake, optional death sounds) with double-trigger guard.
Reserve start tiles for special battle openings and prefer requested tile types during placement.
Retune enemy roster for v0.0.6.1 with gentler early threats, slower obelisk spawns, and toned-down elite/void defenses and payouts.
Refresh run and battle tutorial copy to teach obelisk objective, tile effects, and currencies for v0.0.6.1.
Boss health meter deferred until the boss redesign lands to avoid rework.
Add a reusable card cost selection popup with selectable card grid, hover details, and Events hooks for rituals/events.
Introduce Bulwark and Void Channeler enemies with unique actions and expand tier 1/2 battle pools to feature them.
Overhauled enemy intent display with consistent formatting, tooltips, and palette-based visual polish.
Make enemy AI pick attacks/blocks based on player distance, block, and kill potential instead of flat weights.
Add pulsing tile highlights with pooled sprites and a scan SFX when aiming cards so valid targets are clearly marked without wiping telegraphs.
Shortened discard/draw tweens and reshuffle trails so end-of-turn hand cleanup feels snappier.
Added a quick battle intro vignette/audio dip beat that plays as combat loads without delaying turn 1.
Seeded map event nodes and built a lightweight event room with gold/resource/HP tradeoffs.
Synced battle intro/outro presentation with vignette fades and audio swells around start/end of combat.
Added a map bounty board overlay that lists gold/resource rewards for currently reachable battles.
Started corrosion content expansion: added Corroded status plus Corroding Shot and Corrosion Wave cards to the Riftwalker draft pool.
Added a BattleState controller to own turn/shrink phases and route player/end/enemy loops through validated transitions.
Introduced CardResolver + declarative effect configs and migrated sample damage/block/move/gather cards off get_tree coupling.
Centralized card/movement targeting with a shared TargetSelector that caches valid cells and reuses validators for drag/aim flows.
